title: Illusionist / 幻术师
description:
A standalone mirror-and-illusion character for Slay the Spire 2, with three coupled systems:

- Mirror: "Copy" summons mirror images that replay your first card each turn and shatter when you take unblocked damage.
- Intent: read and reflect enemy telegraphs (Counter, Foresight, Provoke).
- Transmute: temporarily reshape your own cards (Shifting Blade, Myriad Faces, Phantom Blast), with a transmute stack that unwinds one layer per turn.

~40 themed cards, custom relics and potions, a starter relic, and Orobas (Ancient) relic/card upgrades.

Fully localized in English and 简体中文.
changeNote: v0.4.2 - Compatibility, fixes, balance & a new card. NOW REQUIRES Slay the Spire 2 v0.108.0 and the RitsuLib base mod (subscribe to it - it is listed as a required item). Fixes: the Illusionist's portrait is back in the combat top bar; destroying your mirror images with Extract or Sacrifice now correctly ends the Mirror Image echo (it was still replaying your first card). New card: Hall of Mirrors (Rare) - Exhaust your hand; Copy 1 for every 2 cards exhausted (upgraded: exhausting a full hand grants Intangible). Balance: Curtain Call now deals 40/55 and no longer Retains; Extract becomes 0-cost when upgraded (no longer Retain); Reversal now Exhausts; Forewarn no longer gains Innate on upgrade; Catalyze no longer Retains. Renames: Phantasm Storm -> 幻象风暴, and 献祭 -> 献身. Added portrait & power art for several cards. English & 简体中文.
